about.history.title: Unsere Geschichte
about.history.subtitle: Hier erzählen wir, wie alles begann, wer wir sind und was wir tun
about.history.p1: The origins of VianaHub trace back to the union of Claudener Antunes Viana and Tatiana Martins Viana, who met at university in 2007. Two years later, they got married and formed the Viana family, beginning a journey marked by dedication, entrepreneurial spirit, and a commitment to innovation.
about.history.p2: In 2019, with the goal of providing technology services to Portuguese companies, they created a business structure still based in Minas Gerais, Brazil, which began offering IT solutions for the Brazilian and European markets. Three years later, the couple settled permanently in Portugal, consolidating the company's national presence while simultaneously maintaining operations in Brazil.
about.history.p3: Today, VianaHub operates seamlessly across both countries, with a multicultural team and a strategic approach that prioritizes proximity, trust, and technological excellence.
